audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0-5].side are all flat 'Skill' (5-6/10) while content win[0-5] and packet.levelChart both say Vel'Koz wins levels 1 through first-item; phases[6] says Skill while win[6]/packet say Braum.
audit.why: The page currently renders two different verdicts for who wins each stage — the level chart contradicts its own prose underneath it.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0-5].side to Vel'Koz and phases[6].side to Braum, matching win[] and packet, and rewrote each .why to state the actual reason instead of the generic Skill-trade template.

audit.why: Content-layer spikes[] already correctly key to Q+W double-stack at 2, R execute at 6, Liandry's/Torch at first item, and Braum's flank-stun spike late.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Organic Deconstruction (P) and Life Form Disintegration Ray (R) deal true damage on the 3rd stack, bypassing resistances — never stated in the full layer.
audit.why: A support who stacks armor/MR expecting it to blunt Vel'Koz's damage is wrong; the true-damage proc ignores that, so the correct answer is dodging casts, not itemizing resistances.
audit.corrected: Added a Do's entry stating the true-damage mechanic and the correct counterplay.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contains no number at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: The field exists specifically to carry a real, punishable cooldown window.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with Tectonic Disruption's 10-12s CD and Life Form Disintegration Ray's 100/90/80s CD plus its interruptibility.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] (titled 'Trade stacks in the cooldown gap') and dontsFull[2] (titled 'Trade at his max range') both contain the tradeGood/tradeBad string verbatim, unrelated to their titles.
audit.corrected: Rewrote both bodies to match their titles using real ability data.

edits.before: Q-poke the contacts — the stack passive means your carry's autos are CC in progress.
edits.after: He outranges Winter's Bite (1050 vs 1000) and pokes freely through minions from level 1.

edits.before: Concussive trades begin: three hits and the stun votes; trade in stack windows.
edits.after: His Q+W double-stack Organic Deconstruction from well outside your engage range.

edits.before: Full kit: E eats their poke and W teleports the peel — the lane plays through your shield.
edits.after: Tectonic Disruption's slow lets him land poke and kite your Concussive Blows setup.

edits.before: Stack the margins — every traded auto is a quarter-stun; their math hates it.
edits.after: His ramping AP poke keeps you and your ADC pinned back through 4-5.

edits.before: Glacial Fissure online — the line knockup starts dives and ends theirs.
edits.after: His level 6 Life Form Disintegration Ray executes whatever his poke already softened.

edits.before: First item: the wall hardens and the stack windows chain into kills.
edits.after: Liandry's/Blackfire Torch spikes his sustained poke before you have a real answer.

edits.before: Late Braum is the wall: E their teamfight's biggest cast, R their engage, stun whoever touches the carry.
edits.after: Your Q slow into flanking Concussive Blows stun deletes the immobile, escape-less mage.

edits.before: - Vel'Koz Tectonic Disruption: matchup-defining — The knockup starts the true-damage rotation — dodge it and the research stalls. It writes your spacing rules. - E Unbreakable is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Tectonic Disruption (E) is down 10-12s by rank — the knockup starts his true-damage rotation; dodge it and Organic Deconstruction stalls. - Life Form Disintegration Ray (R) is 100/90/80s and a full channel — any CC cancels it, so interrupt rather than just block it. - Save Unbreakable (E) for the Q proc, not routine chip.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: His Q (Plasma Fission) is only 7s cooldown but his only poke tool — trade stacks with your ADC right after he's spent it, not before.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: His Q and W outrange Winter's Bite — walking up to trade just eats free Deconstruction stacks for nothing back.
Don't itemize pure resistances against him
Organic Deconstruction (P) and his R both deal true damage on the 3rd stack — armor/MR doesn't stop it, so dodge casts and use Unbreakable's block instead.

notes: Full-layer level chart was templated flat 'Skill' across all seven rows while content win[]/whys[] and the packet chart already correctly showed Vel'Koz winning 6 of 7 stages — this was exactly the mirror/chart-disagreement defect the brief describes. suspectNames flag on spikes[0].text 'Your Concussive Blows' is a false positive — that is Braum's own correct passive name.
